mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WISH (WELFARE_ID, MEMBER_ID, WISH_DATE) VALUES (#{welfareId}, #{memberId}, SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM WISH WHERE WELFARE_ID = #{welfareId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISH WHERE WELFARE_ID = #{welfareId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
